title: Steller Dreams
creator: Synth-thetic
page_description_verbatim:
A Warm, drifting synth layer unfolds slowly into vast, weightless space—subtle pulses and shimmering textures create a meditative, starlit atmosphere for deep listening.

Absynth 5
DS Thorn
